meta.title: Rendezvous and proximity operations response
meta.authored_by: Claude Opus (illustrative draft, pending Ash authoring)
meta.change_reason: ILLUSTRATIVE content authored to exercise the drill loop, the scoring engine and the interface end to end. Derived only from public open-source material on space domain awareness practice, per the flight plan's public-sources rule. It is NOT a JCO procedure and has not been authored or validated by a subject-matter expert. Ash owns authoring and redaction sign-off; every step, threshold and answer key here is TBC, re-verify.

purpose: Recognise a controlled close approach, distinguish it from an uncontrolled conjunction, and run the response while the geometry is still developing.
entry_conditions: Relative range between two objects is closing in a manner consistent with control rather than natural drift.
An object holds a bounded relative position with respect to another across multiple revolutions.
A manoeuvre assessment concludes the burn was targeted at another object.

steps.action: Establish the relative motion in the along-track, cross-track and radial frame rather than reasoning from range alone.
steps.note: Range alone cannot distinguish a natural drift-by from a held station. The relative track shape can.

steps.action: Determine whether relative motion is bounded or unbounded.
steps.note: A closed relative track that repeats is being maintained. An open hyperbolic-looking pass is drifting through.

steps.action: Estimate time and distance at closest approach with an uncertainty band.
Classify as controlled proximity operations, uncontrolled conjunction, or indeterminate.
steps.warning: Indeterminate is a valid and often correct answer early. Do not force a classification the evidence does not support.

steps.action: Check the object of interest against the protected-object criteria held outside this application.
Increase observation tasking on both objects to shorten the revisit interval.
steps.note: The value of a shorter revisit is highest while the geometry is still changing.

steps.action: Report the approach with the relative geometry, the classification, and the confidence.
Maintain custody until relative range opens and stays open.

threshold_criteria.name: bounded-relative-motion
threshold_criteria.condition: The relative track is closed or repeating, indicating maintained relative position.

threshold_criteria.name: control-authority-evident
threshold_criteria.condition: Relative motion is corrected in a way natural dynamics do not explain.

threshold_criteria.name: closest-approach-inside-band
threshold_criteria.condition: Predicted closest approach falls inside the distance band the criteria set.

reporting_requirements: Both object designators and the relative geometry at the time of report.
Time and distance at closest approach, with uncertainty.
Whether relative motion is bounded, and the evidence for that judgement.
Classification and confidence, with indeterminate stated plainly where it applies.

transition_rules.when: New associated objects appear during the approach.

closure_criteria: Relative range opens and continues to open across subsequent fits.
The approach is reclassified as an uncontrolled conjunction and handed to routine conjunction handling.
